name: Abrams
playstyle: Abrams has the bulk and sustain to lead from the front, often running into the middle of his foes and watching them scatter. If his enemies waste their fire on him, his backline teammates can lay out damage with impunity.

abilities.name: Siphon Life
abilities.quip: Drain health from nearby enemies
abilities.desc: Drain health from nearby enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.
upgrades: +2m Radius and +22.0 DPS with improved Spirit scaling

abilities.name: Shoulder Charge
abilities.quip: Charge into the fray, dragging enemies along
abilities.desc:
Charge forward, pulling enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies stun.
If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.
upgrades: Applies +32.0% Slow for 3s
On Wall Hit: +0.8s Stun Duration

-18s Cooldown
On Hero Collide: +1.5 Weapon Damage for 6s

abilities.name: Infernal Resilience
abilities.quip: Regenerate some of the damage you receive
abilities.desc: Gain bonus defensive attributes. Taking damage grants temporary regeneration for a portion of the damage taken.
upgrades: +20% Debuff Resist and +9% Damage Regenerated

abilities.name: Seismic Impact
abilities.quip: Smash into enemies from above, stunning them
abilities.desc: Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying stun.
upgrades: On cast, become Unstoppable for 5s and +6m Impact Radius

abilities.name: Disengaging Sigil
abilities.desc: Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.
upgrades: Gain +25% Fire Rate and +25% Bullet Speed for 8s
On Player Hit: +1 stamina restored and resets Air Jump/Dash limit
Can be Recast within 4s

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.desc:
Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, immobilizing them, preventing them from parrying, and reducing their Melee Resist.

Press Ability 2 to select a target.
Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.
upgrades: -25% Melee Resist and +0.6s Immobilize Duration
Gain 75% Bullet, Spirit & Melee Lifesteal against the Riposte target for 13s

abilities.name: Flawless Advance
abilities.desc:
Perform a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs ahead of you. Hold your ability key to time your attacks, dealing more damage the longer it's held. Releasing your attack during the perfect window deals maximum damage.

Press Ability 3 to re-cast.
upgrades: Perfect Hit on Hero: Heal 35
-12s Cooldown. Gain +60% Bullet Resist during lunge

+65 Perfect Damage with improved Spirit scaling.
Increased lunge speed & distance.

abilities.name: Itani Lo Sahn
abilities.desc:
Charge up and perform a long range slash. Struck enemies cannot take action or heal and are stuck in slow motion. When this effect expires, they suffer devastating damage, dealing bonus damage against half-health enemies.

While in slow motion, Apollo is invulnerable and enemies take reduced damage.

Hold Ability 4 or to delay the cast.

abilities.name: Threadsap
abilities.quip: Threadsap
abilities.desc:
Weave a scraggly thread that follows your crosshair before bursting along its path, dealing spirit damage and stealing enemy Spirit, increased in effectiveness for Baba.

While holding stolen Spirit, Baba deals bonus spirit damage with every bullet.
upgrades:
-12s Cooldown
+8s Debuff Duration

+1 Charge
On Hit: Pull enemies 7m

abilities.name: Granny Long Legs
abilities.quip: Granny Long Legs: jump high and kick anyone nearby with spirit-charged legs.
abilities.desc:
Your bench's legs extend, granting bonus move speed, higher jumps, Debuff Resistance and Melee Resistance.

Light Melee: Perform a kick that knocks enemies back.
Heavy Melee: Perform a ground pound that applies knockup, slow, and deals spirit damage.

Hold Crouch / slide to charge a high jump, release to jump.
upgrades: +2.5m Move Speed
-7.0s Cooldown

+15% Resists
+50% Melee Lifesteal

abilities.name: Baba's Brew
abilities.quip: Brew Baba's special pot of tea, then throw it to ignite or silence enemies, or shield allies
abilities.desc:
Brew a pot of tea that applies a magical effect in an area when thrown, cycling over time in a random order between a soothing barrier, Silence, or scalding burn that deals spirit damage over time and reduces spirit resist.

Press to pause or resume brewing.
upgrades: +33.33% Brew Effectiveness

abilities.name: Feed The Birds
abilities.desc:
Cover targets in front of you with bread, adding a stacking slow .

When the channel ends a flock of pigeons bombard the targets, dealing spirit damage and hexing each target into a pigeon, increasing in both damage and duration based on bread count.
upgrades:
+4m Cast Range
+32% Max Slow

+125 Max Damage
+125 Spirit Scaling
+0.5s Max Duration

name: Bebop
role: Hooks an enemy for a knockout combo
playstyle: Bebop can string together his abilities in many different ways. Disrupting enemy positions, saving an ally or dealing bursts of damage. When the situation doesn't require subtlety his giant laser still solves many problems.

abilities.name: Exploding Uppercut
abilities.quip: Punch someone away from you
abilities.desc:
Deal melee damage to nearby enemies and apply knockback.

When they land, they deal spirit damage and apply reduced fire rate to other nearby enemies.

Exploding Uppercut can be used on allies.
upgrades: On Hero Hit: Gain fast spin-up time, 2x weapon range and +30% weapon damage for 9s
On Hero Hit: Set Grapple Arm cooldown to 0 and restores +18% of your missing health

abilities.name: Sticky Bomb
abilities.quip: Plant a bomb on an enemy
abilities.desc:
Attach a bomb that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage to nearby enemies.

If the bomb hits or kills a hero, you gain permanent bonus damage on Sticky Bomb.

Stacks diminish by half after 60 hits and 7 kills
upgrades: On Cast: +5m Move Speed and +25% Debuff Resistance for 6s

abilities.name: Grapple Arm
abilities.quip: Pull in a target to you
abilities.desc:
Launch out a mechanical hand that pulls the first character it hits, reeling them in.

Grapple Arm can be used on allies.
upgrades: +20% weapon damage against victims for 6s

abilities.name: Hyper Beam
abilities.quip: Unleash a massive damaging beam
abilities.desc: Channel a powerful torrent of energy that deals spirit damage and applies slow.
upgrades: Hyper Beam heals Bebop for 65% of its damage on Heroes. 20% on non-hero

abilities.name: Bashdown
abilities.desc:
Slam your bat into the ground, pulling enemies down and dealing melee damage.

The slam creates a shockwave that deals spirit damage and applies knockup.
upgrades: -10s Cooldown
+1 Charge and +2m Radius

-3.0s Charge Time
Now deals 50% Heavy Melee Damage

abilities.name: Rising Ram
abilities.desc:
Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy.

Cooldown reduced by 50% on impact.
upgrades: On Impact: +25.0% weapon damage for 5s

abilities.name: Blasted
abilities.desc: Passive: Melee hits restore ammo and inflict wrecked on the victim for 7.0s.
upgrades: While Blasted: +2.25m/s bonus move speed
+1 Bashdown Charge on use and +7% Wrecked Bullet Amp
+50 Melee Bonus Health and increases spirit scaling

abilities.name: Chain Gang
abilities.desc:
Chain nearby enemies to you. Chained enemies cannot use movement abilities and receive a heavy slow when they pull on the chain.

After a delay, yank everyone towards Billy and deal spirit damage.

The chain breaks if you lose line of sight for a short while.
upgrades: +40% spirit resist & bullet resist

+5m Range
+1.3s of Unstoppable Per Hero pulled in

name: Calico
playstyle: Calico uses the shadows to her advantage, weaving in and out of combat to hunt down her enemies one by one.

abilities.name: Gloom Bombs
abilities.quip: Throw out cluster bombs
abilities.desc:
Throw a cluster of bombs that detonate after a delay, dealing spirit damage.

Enemies hit by multiple bombs take 65% damage.
upgrades: Per Bomb Touch : -6% Melee Resist for 6s

abilities.name: Leaping Slash
abilities.quip: Dash forward and slash enemies
abilities.desc:
Dash forward before slashing all enemies in a circle, dealing melee damage.

If the ability hits at least one hero, heal a small amount of health.
upgrades: Heroes killed within 3s grant +200 souls
+90 Damage & On Hero Hit: 50% Cooldown Refund

abilities.name: Ava
abilities.quip: Take control of Ava
abilities.desc:
Turn to shadows and possess Ava. You gain bonus move speed that increases over time, and become hidden on the minimap.

Taking damage from an enemy hero resets your bonus move speed and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.
upgrades: +15 Health Regen & +40% Max Move Speed
Gain Damage Amp over time, up to 18%. Lingers for 8s

abilities.name: Return to Shadows
abilities.quip: Turn to Shadows, gaining movespeed and dealing delayed damage
abilities.desc:
Instantly turn to shadows, becoming untargetable, gaining bonus move speed, and dealing spirit damage.

After a delay, return from the shadows, dealing spirit damage again.
upgrades: +75 Damage and +20% Move Speed
On Completion: Heal for 450 and refund all ability cooldowns

abilities.name: Light Eater
abilities.desc: Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take spirit damage when attacked by Celeste and provides her spirit lifesteal.
upgrades: -10s Cooldown and +3m Cast Range
+22 Damage and Increased Spirit Scaling

abilities.name: Dazzling Trick
abilities.desc: Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.
upgrades: +70 Barrier and Increased Barrier Spirit Scaling
+1.25 Silence Duration and -20s Cooldown. Allows Shining Wonder Bounce.

abilities.name: Radiant Daggers
abilities.desc:
Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals spirit damage to all targets in the area.

Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.

abilities.name: Shining Wonder
abilities.desc:
Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets.

Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.
upgrades: -16% Move Speed and -14% Dash Distance
+90 Damage and Increased Spirit Scaling
+6 Max Bounces and -30s Cooldown

abilities.name: Strix Salvo
abilities.desc:
Launch a salvo of spirit missiles that lodge into the ground along a line. The missiles explode after a delay or upon detecting an enemy, dealing spirit damage and marking the target.

Shooting a marked enemy with a charged shot consumes a mark to deal bonus spirit damage and apply a fading slow.

Hold and drag to select the angle.
upgrades: -12s Cooldown

+30 Damage
+45 Marked Damage
+2 Missiles, Longer Range, and Improved Spirit Scaling

abilities.name: Chimera Mk1
abilities.desc:
Hold Jump / mantle to fly, building up heat. When max heat is reached, your jetpack will begin to overheat.

Overheating: After a short delay, dive to the ground. Upon impact, create an explosion that deals damage and launches you and nearby enemies. If no hero is hit, you stun yourself. Press Ability 2 to dive early.

Cooling Down: After overheating, the jetpack cannot be used until it fully cools down.

Slows affect you while airborne. You always explode on death.
upgrades: Heat vents faster while grounded
On Hero Hit: Heal and take no self damage
On Hero Hit: -50% Cooldown and +120 Spirit Damage

abilities.name: Jettison Fuel
abilities.desc:
Spray fuel dealing weapon damage over time and shredding bullet resist, building up to a huge backblast that deals spirit damage and knocks you backwards.

Vents the jetpack when dealing damage.
upgrades:
+60 Burst Damage
On Backblast Hit: +18% Fire Rate for 7s

-10% Bullet Resist Shred
On Backblast Hit: Apply a Mark

abilities.name: Close The Deal
abilities.desc:
Grab an enemy and give them a hands-on demonstration, flying high into the air before crashing back to the ground.

You and the participant take spirit damage over time while falling and spirit damage upon impact. Damage is increased to enemies under 50% health.
upgrades:
+0.5s Stun
+8.0 Damage / Meter

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.desc: Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing spirit damage. If the enemy is in close range, deal bonus melee damage.
upgrades: -8.0s Cooldown

Deals 55% Heavy Melee Damage
Silences enemies for 2s if close range

abilities.name: Stalker's Mark
abilities.desc:
Send out a mark that bleeds the first target it hits, dealing spirit damage over time.

While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.
upgrades: -8% Bullet Resist
-10s Cooldown and +3s Duration
+1.5% Bleed and -40.0% Incoming Healing

abilities.name: Bloodscent
abilities.desc:
Isolated heroes leave a trail as they move, and emit their heartbeat from afar.

You deal amplified damage against isolated heroes, and when isolated heroes die nearby you gain permanent weapon damage.

Active: Accentuate your senses, revealing a trail that leads to nearby heroes.
upgrades: +3m/s Move Speed when around an isolated enemy hero
On isolated hero death: Heal 24% of your missing health and restores 2 Stamina

abilities.name: Eternal Night
abilities.desc:
Surround nearby enemy heroes in darkness, severely limiting their vision of other units. Affected enemies are briefly revealed to you and are considered isolated for the duration.

You gain bonus sprint speed.
upgrades: +2.75s Duration and +1 Max Target.

name: Dynamo
playstyle: Dynamo keeps himself and his allies healthy while waiting for his moment. Few things can warp a team fight more than a well-coordinated use of Singularity.

abilities.name: Kinetic Pulse
abilities.quip: Release a ground pulse that knocks enemies into the air
abilities.desc: Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying knockup.
upgrades: +1 Charge
On Hit: -15% Bullet Resist and -24% Move Speed for 4s
+135.0 Damage and +20m Cast Range

abilities.name: Quantum Entanglement
abilities.quip: Blink in and out of existence
abilities.desc:
Briefly become untargetable while teleporting to the target location. Restores stamina upon use.

: Bring nearby allies with you.
upgrades:
Reduces non-ult debuffs by 50%
Replenishes 1 Charge

abilities.name: Rejuvenating Aurora
abilities.quip: Heal yourself and those around you
abilities.desc:
While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby.
You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.
upgrades: Aura provides +4m Move Speed during channel
-20.0s Cooldown and +1.0s Duration
Full move and ability use and additionally heals +2.5% of Max Health per second

abilities.name: Singularity
abilities.quip: Pull in and stun the enemy team
abilities.desc: Create a singularity in your hands, dealing spirit damage over time, applying stun, and pulling in nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Jar of Dead
abilities.desc:
Passive: Collect death when anything dies nearby and store it in your Jar of Dead.

Active: Throw a jar to summon Deadheads that repeatedly deal spirit damage to enemies.

Deadheads follow you instead if there's no nearby enemies, and prioritize the target of your weapon.
upgrades: Collecting death heals 5 health per pickup
On Hit: Apply 24% Slow for 1s

+2 Deadheads
+4s Deadhead Lifetime

abilities.name: Grasping Hands
abilities.desc:
Unearth a line of grasping hands, summoning a Ghoul and leaving behind a rift. Enemies who pass through take spirit damage and receive immobilize.

Alt-Cast rotates the orientation of the wall.
upgrades: +90 Damage and +10m Wall Length

+1 Ghouls Raised
-14s Cooldown
+0.75s Immobilize Duration

abilities.name: Essence Theft
abilities.desc: Your weapon steals weapon damage and spirit resist over time, up to a maximum amount per target.
upgrades:
+1 Max Steal Targets
All Summons now apply Essence Theft

abilities.name: Borrowed Decree
abilities.desc:
Innate: Abilities can summon Ghouls that shamble toward the enemy base, dealing melee damage. They explode when they approach a hero or objective, dealing spirit damage in an area and applying a brief slow

Active: Create a gravestone at a target location that summons Ghouls over time. Enemies can destroy the gravestone with two heavy melees.
upgrades:
+25% Ghoul Speed
-15s Cooldown
+10s Duration

On Death: Deal +5% Current Health as Damage
-0.3s Time To Spawn

name: Grey Talon
playstyle: A cunning predator, Grey Talon uses a combination of deadly accuracy, traps, and clever positioning to bring down the toughest of opponents.

abilities.name: Charged Shot
abilities.quip: Charge up a long range shot
abilities.desc: Charge up a powerful shot that pierces through enemies. Hold Ability 1 or to hold the shot.
upgrades: +54.0 Damage and -2s Charge Delay

Improved damage scaling
Ricochets once off walls, floors, and ceilings

abilities.name: Rain of Arrows
abilities.quip: Jump high up in the air and unleash multishots
abilities.desc:
Launches you high in the air, allowing you to glide slowly. While airborne, you gain Weapon Damage and multishot on your weapon.
for reduced jump height.
Press Jump / mantle to cancel the glide.
upgrades: While airborne, +3 Weapon Damage and weapon damage applies 24% movement slow for 1.5s
While airborne, +30% Bullet Lifesteal, +30% Spirit Lifesteal and +30% Bullet Evasion

abilities.name: Spirit Snare
abilities.quip: Place a trap that restricts enemy movement
abilities.desc:
Throw out a trap that begins to arm itself. Once armed, the trap will trigger when an enemy enters its radius, applying Curse and Movement Slow that interrupts, Silences, Disarms, and prevents item usage.
Hit the trap with a Charged Shot to detonate early with increased radius.
upgrades: Applies -15% Bullet Resist for 10s
+1s Curse Duration and +1.5m Radius

abilities.name: Guided Owl
abilities.quip: Fly your owl to damage enemies from afar
abilities.desc:
After 1.5s cast time, launch a spirit owl that you control and which explodes on impact, damaging and stunning enemies. Hold [W] to accelerate the owl.
Press Jump / mantle to release control. Gain permanent Spirit Power for each enemy hero killed with Guided Owl.
upgrades: After hit, kills enemies that are below 22% Health

name: Haze
playstyle: When Haze fixates on a target she can hold her own in a firefight. She prefers to create one sided exchanges, avoiding damage then picking off unsuspecting targets up close.

abilities.name: Sleep Dagger
abilities.quip: Put an enemy to sleep
abilities.desc: Throw a dagger that damages and sleeps the target. Sleeping targets wake up shortly after being damaged. Throwing a Dagger does not break your invisibility. Sleep Dagger does not interrupt enemies' channeling abilities.
upgrades: -10.0% Bullet Resist Reduction for 6.0s on wake-up

+1s Sleep Duration
Applies 15.0 Fixation Stacks

-17.0s Cooldown
-40% Move and Dash Speed for 3s on wake-up

abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
abilities.quip: Fade out of sight
abilities.desc: Fade out of sight, becoming invisible and gaining sprint speed. Attacking removes invisibility, but using items does not. Close enemies can see through your invisibility.
upgrades: Enable 2 Ability Charges

Dispels non-ult debuffs
Grants +50% Bullet Lifesteal for 5s

abilities.name: Fixation
abilities.quip: Deal increasing bullet damage to a target
abilities.desc: Shooting a target increases your bullet damage on that target. Gain one stack per bullet hit, three if the hit is a headshot.
upgrades: 40.0 Spirit damage and 12% slow for 2s to target every 20 stacks
+40 Max Stacks and +5s Duration

+0.11/ per Stack
Scales with Weapon Damage

abilities.name: Bullet Dance
abilities.quip: Unleash a flurry of bullets around you
abilities.desc: Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and added Bullet Damage.
upgrades:
+10.0% Fire Rate
+3m Movespeed

+40.0% Evasion
-65s Cooldown

name: Holliday
playstyle: Holliday depends on her skills as a crack shot, shooting things she's bounced into the air. With good aim she can lay out heavy damage. Her movement skills let her isolate her enemies or beat a hasty retreat.

abilities.name: Powder Keg
abilities.quip: Throw a barrel that explodes when shot
abilities.desc:
Throw a barrel that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage, setting enemies on fire and applying knockup.

The barrel can be detonated early by being shot, melee'd, or detonated by another barrel.

The burn stacks, so overlapping barrels burn for their combined damage.
Can be Alt-Cast to place the barrel in front of Holliday.
upgrades:
+40 Impact Damage
+13.3333 Burn Damage per Second
-5s Charge Time
Improved Spirit Scaling

abilities.name: Bounce Pad
abilities.quip: Send yourself and others flying
abilities.desc:
Drop a bounce pad in the world that launches any hero.

You explode on landing, dealing Damage to any nearby enemies.

The explosion can only occur once per person per Bounce Pad.
upgrades: -10s Cooldown
You and allies gain a +4m/s move speed bonus for 4s on landing
+0.7s Stomp Stun

abilities.name: Crackshot
abilities.quip: Deal bonus damage with headshots
abilities.desc:
Headshots deal bonus Damage and applies a Fading Move Speed penalty. This effect can only occur when off cooldown.

Cooldown is reduced by 50% on NPC hits.
Crackshot ignores range damage fall-off and does not apply to objectives.
upgrades: -20% Fading Move Speed
+49.5 Damage and -6% Bullet Resist for 5s
-6s Cooldown on Hero Headshots. -3s on NPC Headshots

abilities.name: Spirit Lasso
abilities.quip: Grab an enemy and drag them behind you
abilities.desc:
Throw out your lasso, dealing spirit damage, pulling, and applying stun.
Using a Bounce Pad extends the duration of Spirit Lasso.

name: Infernus
role: Lights up enemies and watches them burn
playstyle: Infernus has many ways to deal damage over time, burning foes before swooping in for the kill. Due to Infernus' blazing speed, his enemies won't be able to escape the flames.

abilities.name: Napalm
abilities.quip: Spew napalm that amplifies your damage
abilities.desc: Spew an incendiary mixture, dealing spirit damage, applying slow, and coating targets in napalm.
upgrades: Napalm Effect: +20% Lifesteal
Napalm Effect: +17% Damage Taken and -33% Healing

abilities.name: Flame Dash
abilities.quip: Blaze forward, leaving a flame trail in your wake
abilities.desc:
Dash forward, gaining slow resistance while leaving a flaming trail that deals spirit damage over time.

Hold [W] while active to dash farther.
upgrades: +1.0s Trail Duration and +20.0 DPS
Enable 2 Ability Charges with 14s Recharge time

abilities.name: Afterburn
abilities.quip: Shoot enemies to set them on fire
abilities.desc:
Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing spirit damage over time.

Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.
upgrades: Burn Effect: -35% Spirit Damage
+3.0s Max Burn Duration

abilities.name: Concussive Combustion
abilities.quip: Stun all nearby enemies after a short delay
abilities.desc:
Become a living bomb, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to all nearby enemies after a delay.

Once cast, Concussive Combustion cannot be interrupted.
upgrades: -65.0s Cooldown and +100.0% Explosion Lifesteal

+0.9s Stun Duration and +10m Radius
Increased Spirit Scaling

name: Ivy
role: Sets up a power duo with a lucky ally
playstyle: Ivy has disruptive combat tricks that slow and stun enemies. She's most effective when linking up with an ally, empowering her and her ally's guns as well as sharing heals.

abilities.name: Entangling Thorns
abilities.quip: Damage and slow enemies in the area
abilities.desc: Summon a patch of choking thorns that damages and slows enemies in its radius.
upgrades: +2m Radius and increased DPS Spirit scaling
Enemies caught in thorns for 2.0s are Immobilized for +1.6s

abilities.name: Kudzu Connection
abilities.quip: Empower yourself and a nearby ally
abilities.desc:
Connect with a nearby ally to gain bonuses, replicated healing, and ignore the move speed penalty while shooting.

Receive 50% of Bonuses with no connection
Connection requires line of sight.
upgrades: +8% Fire Rate and +8% Bullet Lifesteal
Ability is always active

abilities.name: Stone Form
abilities.quip: Turn into impervious stone and stun enemies nearby
abilities.desc: Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.
upgrades: +0.75s Stun Duration and increased Damage spirit scaling

abilities.name: Air Drop
abilities.quip: Death from Above! Fly and drop an ally on enemies
abilities.desc:
Grab an ally and take flight with them. Drop your ally to cause an explosion, dealing spirit damage. You and your ally gain increased Outgoing Damage when flying ends.

Cooldown reduced by 30% when used on allies.
Taking damage briefly disables using the ability.
While lifted, your ally cannot attack and deals -20% damage.
upgrades: On Fly End : 300 Barrier to Ivy and ally that scales with Spirit
+32% Slow for 3s on enemies hit

Silence for 3s on enemies hit.
Increases damage and barrier scaling.

name: Kelvin
playstyle: Timely heals and splitting a teamfight properly is the difference between an easy victory or a ruinous defeat. Gliding around slowing enemies gives Kelvin's team the maneuvering advantage to make this happen.

abilities.name: Frost Grenade
abilities.quip: Damage and slow enemies
abilities.desc: Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that heals allies and applies spirit damage and move speed reduction to enemies.
upgrades: +30 Damage and +30 Heal Amount
-10 Cooldown and debuff now freezes Stamina Regen
+2m Radius. Damage and Heal Spirit Scaling increased.

abilities.name: Ice Path
abilities.quip: Speed around on a floating path of ice
abilities.desc:
Kelvin creates a floating trail of ice and snow that gives movement bonuses to him and his allies. Kelvin gains 60% slow resistance for the duration. Enemies can also walk on the floating trail.
Press Dash / Crouch / slide to travel up or down while in Ice Path.
upgrades: +2m Move Speed and +35% Bullet Resist for Kelvin while on Ice Path
+35% Spirit and +20 Spirit for Kelvin while on Ice Path

abilities.name: Arctic Beam
abilities.quip: Apply an escalating slow
abilities.desc: Shoot freezing cold energy out in front of you, damaging targets and progressively reducing their movement and fire rate the longer you sustain the beam on them. You have reduced move speed while using Arctic Beam. The beam may also claim Souls.
upgrades: -20.0% to Fire Rate and Move Speed
+20.0 DPS and increased Spirit Scaling
-13s Cooldown and Fires 2 additional Arctic Beams within 10m of the last target hit.

abilities.name: Frozen Shelter
abilities.quip: Create an impenetrable healing dome
abilities.desc:
Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid regeneration and enemies are slowed.

Objectives become Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter
upgrades:
+1.5s Duration
Applies -20% Fire Rate

Purges non-ult debuffs for you and your allies.
+75 Health Regen and increased Spirit Scaling

name: Lady Geist
role: Sacrifices health then drains it back
playstyle: Expending health to achieve devastating effects is the source of Lady Geist's power. When running low, she can drain the life out of her rivals.

abilities.name: Essence Bomb
abilities.quip: Sacrifice some health to launch a damaging bomb
abilities.desc:
Sacrifice some of your health to launch a bomb that deals damage after a brief arm time.
Self damage type is Spirit and can be mitigated.
upgrades: +2m Radius and +50.0 Damage.
Bombs leave a toxic mess on the ground, dealing 30.0% of the original damage per second, for 6s.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.quip: Steal health from an enemy over time
abilities.desc:
Create a tether that drains enemy health over time and heals you. Target must be in line of sight and within max range to drain. You can shoot and use other abilities during the drain, but your move speed is reduced.
to give health to friendly Heroes.
upgrades: Enables and Grants +2 Charges. Increases spirit scaling.

abilities.name: Malice
abilities.quip: Stack damage amplification on an enemy
abilities.desc: Sacrifice some of your health to launch blood shards that apply a stack of Malice. Each stack slows the victim and increases the damage they take from you. The slow effect decreases over time.
upgrades: +25.199999 Damage and +4 Blood Shards
+8% Damage Amp

abilities.name: Soul Exchange
abilities.quip: Swap your current health with an enemy hero's
abilities.desc: Swaps health levels with an enemy target. There is a minimum health percentage that enemies can be brought down to and a minimum amount of health received based on victims current health.
upgrades: Silence enemies within 25m for 3s
